Why is Mongolia divided into Inner Mongolia and Outer Mongolia even today? The brutal fall of the mighty Mongol Empire, the rise of the Qing Dynasty, deadly tribal betrayals, the role of Buddhism, and how World War 2 and the Yalta Conference (1945) permanently sealed Mongolia’s fate. From Genghis Khan’s unstoppable conquests to modern geopolitics and power games between China, USSR, and the West this is the full breakdown of how one of history’s greatest empires was split forever.
